svg.aria-label: Commit Metro: my last 53 weeks of GitHub contributions as Namma Metro trains on the purple line, one train per week and one coach per day, with lit windows for days I committed. 207 contributions since 05 Oct. The trains stop at a station for each of my busiest repos: vfd-explorer, tripppyyy, Alpha-Fin, Vyuha-Network, AllergySafe. This week's train ends next to Commit Street, where $VJK trades at ₹60.60.

g.text: Each train is a week, each coach a day. Lit windows are commits.
